message:
Create a standalone Three.js interactive RED FIRE page at D:/Programacion/jpagents/proyects/fuego_rojo/index.html (create the folder first). Requirements:

1. USE THREE.JS via importmap from CDN
2. RED FIRE with well-defined flames — debe ser ROJO intenso, no violeta, no naranja.
3. Gradient palette: white-hot center → bright red → deep crimson → dark red → black fade
4. 3000+ particles with THREE.Points + BufferGeometry + ShaderMaterial custom
5. Flame movement: sinusoidal sway + micro-turbulence + buoyancy (ascending)
6. Interactive: particles follow mouse, click = explosion, scroll wheel = intensity
7. Opacity fade: starts at 65% life, alpha 0 at death
8. Particle size: 0.07-0.35 base, expands with age
9. Lifecycle: ~3s per particle, auto-recycles
10. Ambient glow: 2 radial sprites (red) following mouse
11. Soft fog for distance blending
12. Fullscreen responsive, no scroll, orthographic camera
13. Touch support (tap = explosion, drag = follow finger)
14. Dark background (#0a0000) to make red fire pop
The page must be a SINGLE self-contained index.html with everything from CDN. No external files.
